question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ha na-egwu bọọlụ' pụtara:
explanation: 'Ha na-egwu bọọlụ' pụtara 'they are playing football' n'asụsụ Bekee.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ọgwụ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ọgwụ' pụtara 'medicine' n'asụsụ Bekee. Nri=food, Mmiri=water, Ego=money.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, 'Omu' bụ:
explanation: 'Omu' n'ọdịnala Igbo bụ onye isi obodo ma ọ bụ onye ndu.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, aha mbụ nke eze Nri bụ:
explanation: Aha mbụ nke eze Nri n'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo bụ Eze Nri Ìfikuọjim.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Eze mụọ nwa, eze adaala' pụtara:
option_a: A king who gives birth is not a king
option_b: A king's child will become king
option_c: A king's child is not a king
option_d: When a king gives birth, the kingdom suffers
explanation: Ilu 'Eze mụọ nwa, eze adaala' pụtara na mgbe eze mụrụ nwa, eze enweghị ike ịchị eze nke ọma.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ọ bịara ụnyaahụ' pụtara:
explanation: 'Ọ bịara ụnyaahụ' pụtara 'he came yesterday' n'asụsụ Bekee.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Akwụkwọ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Akwụkwọ' pụtara 'book', 'paper', ma ọ bụ 'letter' n'asụsụ Bekee.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, 'Iri ji' bụ emume:
explanation: 'Iri ji' bụ emume iri ji ọhụrụ n'afọ nke ndị Igbo na-eme.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Aboh:
explanation: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Aboh 'Igwe Aboh'.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Onye ji ihe rie ihe' pụtara:
explanation: Ilu 'Onye ji ihe rie ihe' pụtara na onye nwere ihe ga-eri ihe.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ọ na-ekwu okwu' pụtara:
explanation: 'Ọ na-ekwu okwu' pụtara 'he is talking' n'asụsụ Bekee.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ọkụ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ọkụ' pụtara 'fire' n'asụsụ Bekee. Mmiri=water, Ikuku=air, Ala=earth.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, 'Ọfọ' bụ ihe nnọchianya nke:
explanation: 'Ọfọ' n'ọdịnala Igbo bụ ihe nnọchianya nke eziokwu na ikpe ziri ezi.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, aha eze Nri nke atọ bụ:
explanation: Aha eze Nri nke atọ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo bụ Eze Nri Ọmalọ.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Aka nri ata aka ekpe' pụtara:
option_c: The right hand washes the left
explanation: Ilu 'Aka nri ata aka ekpe' pụtara na anyị kwesịrị inyere ibe anyị aka.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Anyị ga-ala ụlọ' pụtara:
explanation: 'Anyị ga-ala ụlọ' pụtara 'we will go home' n'asụsụ Bekee.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ego' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ego' pụtara 'money' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọlaedo=gold, Ọlaọcha=silver, Akụ=wealth.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, 'Igba Mgbá' bụ emume:
explanation: 'Igba Mgbá' bụ emume agbamakwụkwọ nke ndị Igbo na-eme.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Oguta:
explanation: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Oguta 'Igwe Oguta'.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Ọnụ bụ ọnụ, anya bụ anya' pụtara:
explanation: Ilu 'Ọnụ bụ ọnụ, anya bụ anya' pụtara na ịnụ ihe abụghị ịhụ ya.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ọ na-esi nri' pụtara:
explanation: 'Ọ na-esi nri' pụtara 'he is cooking' n'asụsụ Bekee.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Mmiri' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Mmiri' pụtara 'water' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọkụ=fire, Ikuku=air, Ala=earth.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, 'Ọnwa Asatọ' bụ ọnwa:
explanation: 'Ọnwa Asatọ' bụ ọnwa Ọgọọst n'ọdịnala Igbo, ọnwa a na-eme emume iri ji.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, aha eze Nri nke anọ bụ:
explanation: Aha eze Nri nke anọ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo bụ Eze Nri Ọkpọ.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Onye kwe, Chi ya ekwe' pụtara:
option_a: If you agree, your god will agree
option_b: If you work, you will succeed
option_c: If you pray, God will answer
option_d: If you run, you will catch
explanation: Ilu 'Onye kwe, Chi ya ekwe' pụtara na ihe ọ bụla mmadụ kwenyere ime, Chi ya ga-enyere ya aka ime ya.
